title: PairCLIP-SWA: Similarity-Guided Balancing and Stochastic Weight Averaging for Generalized Deepfake Image Detection with OpenCLIP
abstract: arXiv:2610.37874v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deepfake detectors are almost always deployed as the single checkpoint that scored best on a validation split, yet the reliability of that choice is rarely measured. We measure it with PairCLIP-SWA, a single-backbone detector that adapts an OpenCLIP ViT-L/14 visual tower by progressive block unfreezing on a class-balanced corpus built by CLIP-similarity-guided one-to-one subsampling, and averages the fine-tuning trajectory in weight space. Trained in-domain on the IEEE SP Cup 2025 (DF-Wild-Cup) benchmark under the same protocol as the strongest published three-backbone ensemble, the weight-averaged detector reaches 97.04% accuracy, 98.64% AU-ROC and a 4.07% equal error rate, against 94.46%, 97.60% and 5.00%. translated_title: PairCLIP-SWA：基于OpenCLIP的相似度引导均衡采样与随机权重平均用于泛化性深度伪造图像检测
translated_abstract: 深度伪造检测器几乎总是以在验证集上得分最高的单一检查点形式部署，然而这一选择的可靠性却很少被衡量。我们通过PairCLIP-SWA来衡量这一可靠性，这是一种单骨干检测器，它在由CLIP相似度引导的一对一子采样构建的类别均衡语料库上，通过渐进式块解冻来适配OpenCLIP ViT-L/14视觉塔，并在权重空间中对微调轨迹进行平均。在与已发表的最强三骨干集成模型相同的协议下，在IEEE SP Cup 2025（DF-Wild-Cup）基准上进行域内训练后，权重平均后的检测器达到97.04%的准确率、98.64%的AU-ROC和4.07%的等错误率，而基线模型分别为94.46%、97.60%和5.00%。其训练日志显示了权重平均之所以重要的原因：在被平均的各轮训练中，未平均的检查点在验证准确率上波动达5.34个百分点，其验证损失更翻了一倍多，而平均值的表现从不更差，并且……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出PairCLIP-SWA，通过CLIP相似度引导的类别均衡采样与对微调轨迹的随机权重平均（SWA）来适配OpenCLIP ViT-L/14，以单骨干检测器在IEEE SP Cup 2025深度伪造检测基准上取得97.04%准确率和4.07%等错误率，超越了三骨干集成模型。
en_tdlr: PairCLIP-SWA combines CLIP-similarity-guided balanced subsampling with stochastic weight averaging over the fine-tuning trajectory of an OpenCLIP ViT-L/14 backbone, enabling a single-checkpoint detector to reach 97.04% accuracy on the IEEE SP Cup 2025 deepfake benchmark and outperform a three-backbone ensemble.
